findings.comment: fetchUser hammers the endpoint after a 429 response because no delay is inserted between attempts; the rate limiter rejects the burst.

finding_contract.current_impact: Every retry after a 429 is rejected, so the call fails for users today.
finding_contract.falsifiable_condition: Return 429 once and watch the second attempt.
finding_contract.expected_observable: A second request within the same millisecond.
finding_contract.headline: Retry loop never backs off
